dct_description_sm: Côte d'Ivoire administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 33 District, Autonomous City - Admin 2: 108 Region - Admin 3: 510 Department Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 06 July 2018: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 06 August 2018: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 06 August 2018: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA West and Central Africa (ROWCA)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-rowca). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Comité National de Télédétection et d'Information Géographique (CNTIG)
